author: Opentrons

steps.title: Load deck and pipettes
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons OT‑2 robot on the bench, install the P50 single‑channel pipette and the P300 multi‑channel pipette, and prepare the Invitrogen ChargeSwitch gDNA Kit reagents.

steps.title: Arrange labware on deck
steps.instruction: Load the following labware into the indicated slots: Slot 1 – Bio‑Rad 96‑well plate (200 µL capacity) clean and empty for final elution; Slot 2 – Opentrons 50/300 µL tip rack; Slot 3 – Opentrons 50/300 µL tip rack; Slot 4 – Opentrons magnetic module with a 96‑deep‑well plate (2.4 mL) pre‑filled with 200 µL of sample; Slot 5 – Opentrons 50/300 µL tip rack; Slot 6 – empty.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 App, input any required protocol parameters for the ChargeSwitch gDNA purification (e.g., sample identifiers, volumes, incubation times).

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated OT‑2 protocol file for the gDNA purification to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Verify deck layout
steps.instruction: Confirm that the deck layout displayed in the OT‑2 App matches the physical arrangement described in step 2.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT‑2 App to calibrate the deck positions, tip racks, and both the P50 single‑channel and P300 multi‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Execute the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the automated genomic DNA purification.
